items.title: London market tech gap widens for brokers following Blueprint Two cancellation
items.summary: The collapse of Blueprint Two leaves London market insurers to modernise independently, magnifying operational divides for brokers.

items.title: MNK International appoints Danny Greenaway to lead new aviation and aerospace division
items.summary: MNK International has appointed industry veteran Danny Greenaway as Managing Director to oversee the launch of its new Aviation and Aerospace division in London.

items.title: Law firms report rising enquiries as pension trustees weigh superfund transfers
items.summary: UK pension scheme trustees and sponsoring employers are increasingly exploring superfund transfers as an alternative to traditional buy-ins and buyouts.

items.title: Injured insurance executive sues Slater and Gordon over botched Tui claim
items.summary: A former insurance executive is suing Slater and Gordon for £4.5m after the law firm sent court papers to the wrong email address, causing her personal injury claim against Tui to be struck out.

items.title: Hacked software update grounds German army drones and tests cyber exclusions
items.summary: A cyberattack on Quantum Systems' update server has grounded German military drones and brought supplier risk into focus.

items.title: UK government announces competency framework for pension trustees
items.summary: The government is developing a competency framework for trustees following its consultation on governance.
